scope: Opening straight only, unchanged 24-car Cedar grid. Spatial field spread is a diagnostic, not a target to minimise: a stretched or compact field can both race well.
boundaryBasis: Authored start of First braking zone, 280 m from the start line; initial grid is behind the line. This is geometry, not each car's actual brake onset.
precision: Linearly interpolated 10 Hz car-centre progress/offset/speed; rank ties retained within 1 cm spatially and 1 ms at gates. Centre gaps ignore lateral separation and are not clearance or proof that passing is possible.
